AND am.dept_id = #{params.deptId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mem_growth_action ( action_no, dept_id, dept_name, action_type, action_title, source_type, pressure_level, candidate_count, executed_count, status, action_reason, suggested_script, effect_window_days, tenant_id, del_flag, create_by, create_time ) VALUES ( #{actionNo}, #{deptId}, #{deptName}, #{actionType}, #{actionTitle}, #{sourceType}, #{pressureLevel}, #{candidateCount}, 0, #{status}, #{actionReason}, #{suggestedScript}, #{effectWindowDays}, #{tenantId}, '0', #{createBy}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO mem_growth_action_member ( action_id, member_id, member_no, member_name, dept_id, segment_type, growth_value, card_type, last_active_time, candidate_reason, execute_status, repurchased, signed_in, growth_increased, tenant_id, create_by, create_time ) VALUES ( #{actionId}, #{memberId}, #{memberNo}, #{memberName}, #{deptId}, #{segmentType}, #{growthValue}, #{cardType}, #{lastActiveTime}, #{candidateReason}, 'PENDING', '0', '0', '0', #{tenantId}, #{createBy}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE mem_growth_action SET executed_count = #{executedCount}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE action_id = #{actionId}

UPDATE mem_growth_action_member SET execute_status = #{params.executeStatus}, execute_note = #{params.executeNote}, execute_time = NOW() WHERE action_id = #{params.actionId} AND member_id = #{params.memberId} AND execute_status IN ('PENDING', 'IN_PROGRESS')
mapper.select: SELECT id, action_id AS actionId, member_id AS memberId, member_no AS memberNo, member_name AS memberName, dept_id AS deptId, segment_type AS segmentType, growth_value AS growthValue, card_type AS cardType, last_active_time AS lastActiveTime, candidate_reason AS candidateReason, execute_status AS executeStatus, execute_note AS executeNote, execute_time AS executeTime, repurchased, signed_in AS signedIn, growth_increased AS growthIncreased FROM mem_growth_action_member WHERE action_id = #{actionId} ORDER BY CASE execute_status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 0 WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 WHEN 'DONE' THEN 2 WHEN 'IGNORED' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, member_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mem_growth_action_member WHERE action_id = #{actionId}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT am.id) AS totalMemberCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN am.repurchased = '1' OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM fin_sale_record r WHERE r.member_id = am.member_id AND r.del_flag = '0' AND r.sale_date >= a.create_time AND r.sale_date < DATE_ADD(a.create_time, INTERVAL a.effect_window_days DAY) ) THEN am.id END) AS repurchaseMemberCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN am.signed_in = '1' OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM mem_member_sign_in si WHERE si.member_id = am.member_id AND si.sign_date >= DATE(a.create_time) AND si.sign_date < DATE_ADD(DATE(a.create_time), INTERVAL a.effect_window_days DAY) ) THEN am.id END) AS signInMemberCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN am.growth_increased = '1' OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM mem_member m WHERE m.member_id = am.member_id AND m.del_flag = '0' AND m.growth_value > am.growth_value ) THEN am.id END) AS growthIncreasedMemberCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN am.repurchased = '1' OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM fin_sale_record r WHERE r.member_id = am.member_id AND r.del_flag = '0' AND r.sale_date >= a.create_time AND r.sale_date < DATE_ADD(a.create_time, INTERVAL a.effect_window_days DAY) ) OR am.signed_in = '1' OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM mem_member_sign_in si WHERE si.member_id = am.member_id AND si.sign_date >= DATE(a.create_time) AND si.sign_date < DATE_ADD(DATE(a.create_time), INTERVAL a.effect_window_days DAY) ) OR am.growth_increased = '1' OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM mem_member m WHERE m.member_id = am.member_id AND m.del_flag = '0' AND m.growth_value > am.growth_value ) THEN am.id END) AS effectiveMemberCount FROM mem_growth_action_member am INNER JOIN mem_growth_action a ON am.action_id = a.action_id AND a.del_flag = '0' WHERE am.action_id = #{actionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE mem_growth_action_member am INNER JOIN mem_growth_action a ON am.action_id = a.action_id SET am.repurchased = CASE WHEN EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM fin_sale_record r WHERE r.member_id = am.member_id AND r.del_flag = '0' AND r.sale_date >= a.create_time AND r.sale_date < DATE_ADD(a.create_time, INTERVAL a.effect_window_days DAY) ) THEN '1' ELSE am.repurchased END, am.signed_in = CASE WHEN EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM mem_member_sign_in si WHERE si.member_id = am.member_id AND si.sign_date >= DATE(a.create_time) AND si.sign_date < DATE_ADD(DATE(a.create_time), INTERVAL a.effect_window_days DAY) ) THEN '1' ELSE am.signed_in END, am.growth_increased = CASE WHEN EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM mem_member m WHERE m.member_id = am.member_id AND m.del_flag = '0' AND m.growth_value > am.growth_value ) THEN '1' ELSE am.growth_increased END, am.update_time = NOW() WHERE am.action_id = #{actionId}
